name: ntr_db_es_donut_chart
xsql:
SELECT 
    -- Grand Total Payout for Donut Center
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(SUM(amount), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS v_total_payout_val,

    -- Mix Percentages
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / CASE WHEN SUM(amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(amount) END, 0), 0) AS v_onc_mix_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / CASE WHEN SUM(amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(amount) END, 0), 0) AS v_wh_mix_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / CASE WHEN SUM(amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(amount) END, 0), 0) AS v_oh_mix_pct,

    -- Raw Payouts for Legend
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS v_onc_payout_val,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS v_wh_payout_val,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS v_oh_payout_val

FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.amount,
        m.category
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    INNER JOIN (
        -- Inlined Participant Title Mapping Query
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
            ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta 
        ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    INNER JOIN  NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
        AND pta.title_name = m.title
        
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
) raw_data;
